import subprocess,json,sys,os
base={'primitive':'allreduce','mode':2,'root':0,'segments':1,'words':1,'capacity':1,'start':0,'events':[]}
tests=[]
def add(name,raw):tests.append((name,raw if isinstance(raw,bytes) else raw.encode()))
add('empty stdin',b'')
add('bad json',b'{')
add('nonfile',b'{"cases":[],"x":1}')
add('cases type',b'{"cases":{}}')
add('bool mode',json.dumps({'cases':[{**base,'mode':True}]}))
add('extra key',json.dumps({'cases':[{**base,'zzz':1}]}))
add('missing key',json.dumps({'cases':[{k:v for k,v in base.items() if k!='root'}]}))
add('trace bool',json.dumps({'cases':[{**base,'trace':False}]}))
add('bad primitive',json.dumps({'cases':[{**base,'primitive':'foo'}]}))
add('bad value',json.dumps({'cases':[{**base,'events':[{'op':'data','rank':0,'p':0,'values':[1.0]}]}]}))
add('extra op key',json.dumps({'cases':[{**base,'events':[{'op':'flush','x':1}]}]}))
add('xor off',json.dumps({'cases':[{**base,'events':[{'op':'data','rank':0,'p':0,'xor':[[58,1]]}]}]}))
add('tag surrogate',b'{"cases":[{"primitive":"allreduce","mode":2,"root":0,"segments":1,"words":1,"capacity":1,"start":0,"events":[{"op":"snap","tag":"\\ud800"}]}]}')
add('dup keys',b'{"cases":[],"cases":[]}')
add('nan',b'{"cases":[],"x":NaN}')
add('trail',b'{"cases":[]} {}')
add('oversize',b' '* (4*1024*1024+1))
for name,raw in tests:
 p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'project/solver.py'],input=raw,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
 ok=p.returncode==0 and p.stdout==b'{"error":"invalid"}\n'
 print(('OK' if ok else 'FAIL'),name,p.returncode,p.stdout[:80],p.stderr[:80])
# empty
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'project/solver.py'],input=b' {"cases": []} \n',stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
print('empty valid',p.returncode,p.stdout,p.stderr)
